cause.label: management_or_governance
cause.what_happened: At 09:04 ET on 2026-09-23, before the open, Alkami said its board had unanimously ended the strategic review and would stay an independent public company, abandoning the sale process it launched in August 2026 under pressure from activist JANA Partners (6.3% holder). The stock gapped from $18.09 to a $15.69 open and extended lower through the session as the takeover premium came out.
